_why: The one-shot effects were synthesized placeholders. These prompts re-render them in the world bible's material vocabulary — wet stone, cold water, thick paper, worked glass — and deliberately dry, because the scene's reverb is the scene's job, not the sample's. A one-shot with a baked tail smears when it fires every 0.38 s under a running player.
_excluded: amb_valley, amb_night and sfx_water are NOT regenerated. All three are looping beds; amb_night in particular was synthesized to loop seamlessly (score pass 4), and a generated clip has no matching head and tail, so swapping it buys a click every loop. Replacing those needs a loop-aware pass, not a prompt.

effects.prompt: Foley recording of one single footstep, a leather boot sole landing firmly on a flagstone floor, loud and close, dry studio, no reverb, no background noise
A soft cloth and boot push-off from damp stone, a low scuff with a breath of fabric, dry and close, no reverb
A small cold object lifted off stone into a cloth bag, one short clink of glass followed by muffled fabric, dry and close
A single loud dry wooden knock, one knuckle rap on a wooden door, starts immediately, close microphone, no reverb
A single sheet of thick handmade paper being unfolded once, dry crisp fibres, close and quiet, no music
A single sheet of thick handmade paper folded shut and pressed flat, soft, close and quiet, no music
A single clear soft tap of a fingertip on thick paper, immediate, dry, close microphone
One single sharp wooden tick, a hard bead dropped once onto a wooden desk, loud, close, dry studio, no reverb, no background noise
A brief gust of cold wind moving through wet grass and low leaves, soft and airy, rising and falling once, no howl, no whistle

_processing: Raw generations are not shippable: measured onsets up to 210 ms, peaks from 0.00 (silent) to 0.97. Every one-shot is therefore trimmed to its onset and peak-normalised, and written as 44.1 kHz WAV rather than re-encoded to MP3 — a one-shot that fires every 0.38 s cannot carry a fifth of a second of leading silence.
